Regional/Sub- Regional Offices

Subject: Instructions with regard to the prevention of fraudulent payment by
making 100% payment through CBS/NEFT.
Sir,
Kindly refer to this office circulars no. Bkg./Fraud/05/18210 dated
22.11.2011, Bkg./Fraud/05/15614 dated 24.11.2011, Bkg/Fraud/05/39906 dated
20.12.2011, Bkg./Fraud/05/22901 dated 20.01.2012, Bkg/Fraud/05/45354 dated
27.01.2012, Bkg/Fraud/0S/75956 dated 01.02.2012 and Bkg./Fraud/05/Vol.[1/40764
dated 15.03.2013 (posted at sl. no. 405, 408, 460, 508, 519, 530 and 655 respectively
under Office Orders/Circulars on the official website of EPFO).

2. In continuation to the above circulars, all concerned are again advised to
ensure that in the cases of payment where beneficiaries ask for payment in SBI or in a
Bank which has IFS Code and is NEFT enabled, payment should be made through CBS
or NEFT only irrespective of quantum of payment i.e. within or beyond the limit
prescribed under circular dated 24.11.2011.

Yous faithfully,

\
